title: TypeSomething CTA card
description: A closing call to action: a wide ink card with 48px corners on paper-grey, lit by two dim radial lights (blush top-left, acid bottom-right), a light white heading that can end with the two-tone wordmark, a soft paragraph, an acid pill that lifts on hover and a line of small print.
notes: the card forces the theme's dark colours (class dark), so it stays an ink card on a light page
